items.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Speed Agentic Creation
items.excerpt: Adobe is optimizing its agentic creative apps Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D for NVIDIA's RTX Spark superchip, claiming up to 2x faster AI processing, editing, color and effects, and accelerating Frame.io and Brand Concierge in the cloud.

items.title: Maxon releases Cinema 4D 2027.0
items.excerpt: Cinema 4D 2027.0 adds a new object scattering system and liquid-sim updates; the new Scene Nodes field and effector work with the MCP Server added in 2026.4, so third-party AI tools such as Claude Desktop or ChatGPT Desktop can drive them.

items.title: I ran Blender via Nvidia's new RTX Spark AI agent - here's what happened
items.excerpt: A beginner tests RTX Spark's built-in local agents (Hermes, Perplexity, OpenClaw), which can operate creative apps directly, by asking one to run Blender, and weighs whether agents as 'teammates' really free creatives for more making.

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo accused of using AI in expectations music video
items.excerpt: Viewers spotted glitches, including a cameo missing an arm, in Olivia Rodrigo's new music video and accused the production of using generative AI, the latest flashpoint over undisclosed AI in commercial creative work.

items.title: Build by Design: New workflows for new ways of building
items.excerpt: Figma's Config India recap: beyond code layers and Specs, design systems can now carry guidelines and import code sources from a GitHub repo or npm package so agents build and edit components that follow the team's patterns, plus a preview of a single home for all system libraries.

items.title: Create, ship, and manage data-backed websites with Payload in Figma
items.excerpt: Payload, the open-source headless CMS whose team joined Figma, is now built into Figma Make so teams can build and host sites and apps with a built-in backend and manage content and data from prototype to production.

items.title: More control over your design systems | Figma
items.excerpt: Figma demo: add guidelines to published libraries and import code sources from GitHub or npm so the Figma agent reflects your design system when it builds components and code layers.

items.title: AI News: 6 New Models & A Nano Banana Killer
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe's weekly roundup tests Krea 3 image editing, Google's Gemini 4 Argon and Meta's Muse Wonder, plus new open-weight models, OpenAI updates and Grok Voice 3.0.

items.title: Is Your Organization Messing Up AI Adoption?
items.excerpt: Paul Boag revisits his book Digital Adaptation to show how lessons from digital transformation apply to AI adoption in design and digital teams, and where organizations are repeating the same mistakes.

items.title: I ran a 7-week AI workshop for designers (that wasn't really about AI)
items.excerpt: Lai-Jing Chu on running a 7-week vibe-coding workshop for designers: what designers really needed to know about shipping to production, and what they wanted from online learning.

items.title: The AI experience doesn't care about your org chart
items.excerpt: Kate Agena argues AI is merging content design, enterprise content strategy, knowledge management and model behavior into one user experience, and DesignOps ways of working haven't caught up.

items.title: Nobody wants your AI app
items.excerpt: Dan Maccarone argues buyers want AI that disappears into existing platforms rather than standalone AI apps, and what that shift means for product designers.

items.title: Figma MCP + Claude Code: Give It Your Real Layout, Variables, and Components
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of Figma's official hosted MCP server letting Claude Code read a linked frame's layout, variables and components instead of guessing from a screenshot.

items.title: Comparing AI video models side by side: one prompt through Veo, Kling and Seedance
items.excerpt: A side-by-side planning comparison of Veo, Kling and Seedance for one prompt, with prices and specs from public model pages (author works on Vidlark).

items.title: I asked an AI app builder for a "simple" landing page. Here's what it actually built.
items.excerpt: MODEL, a weekly magazine that tests AI tools, asks an AI app builder for a simple landing page and documents what it actually produced.

items.title: MCP Events support in Vercel Connect is now in public beta
items.excerpt: Vercel Connect now supports the MCP Events protocol extension, so agents can monitor updates from MCP servers and act when events arrive.
